text: ZHU Man1 , WANG Dong-xiao1 , MU Yan2 (1. Department of Pharmaceutical Care, PLA General Hospital, Beijing 100853, China;2. Department of Pharmacy, Qianfoshan Hospital of Shandong Province, Ji'nan 250014, China)[ABSTRACT] One female patient with renal transplant was admitted into hospital for pulmonary infection. After admission, the patient received the concomitant administration of voriconazole and tacrolimus (FK506). Clinical pharmacists paid more attention to the drug interaction between voriconazole and FK506, and monitored closely the blood drug concentration of FK506. During the combination use of voriconazole and FK506, the concentration of FK506 markedly increased. In order to obtain good therapeutic effect and avoid adverse drug reactions, the dose of FK506 was adjusted to 1/4 of the initial dose with the participation of the clinical pharmacists through the monitoring of blood drug concentration. Therefore, the blood drug concentration of FK506 should be monitored closely, the dose of FK506 should be adjusted in consideration of the drug interaction between voriconazole and FK506.专用溶媒进行配制，并与推荐的溶媒配伍，选择合适的滴速，滴注过程中注意密切监护[6]，之后未再出现严重的局部静脉损伤病例。
